resources.string:
👋 I'm RootGenie — your AI root assistant.

Ask me to control your device in Arabic or English, or describe a Magisk module and I'll build & install it for you.

Examples:
• "what is my battery status"
• "change density to 420"
• "build me a performance tweaks module"
Ask anything, or describe a module…
Describe the module you want…\ne.g. "module that boosts touch responsiveness and disables logging"

Works with any OpenAI-compatible endpoint:
• OpenAI: https://api.openai.com/v1
• Gemini: https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai
• OpenRouter: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1
• Local PC: http://PC-IP:1234/v1 (LM Studio)
✅ AI works out of the box — built-in key is active, no setup needed. Want your own key instead? Just paste it below.
Using your personal key (built-in key stays as a fallback).
No built-in AI in this build — pick a provider below and paste a key (free Groq: console.groq.com/keys).
built-in key active — leave empty to use it
⚡ Free AI providers — tap to auto-fill
Fields filled ✔ Now paste your API key and hit Save
Local preset filled — change the IP to your PC\'s address, then Save
No key at all — paste one below (free Groq: console.groq.com/keys).

How to get a FREE key (1 minute, no card):
• Google Gemini: aistudio.google.com/apikey → Create API key
• OpenRouter: openrouter.ai/keys (free models: openrouter.ai/models?max_price=0)
• Groq: console.groq.com/keys
Then: paste key above → Save → Test connection.
